## Design

### 2026-10-09 – So this is the first entry. I started off by researching FPGA's.. and selected the Lattice ECP5 FPGA. I then verified the 256-ball BGA footprint and pad mapping - reading the CSVs was a headache lol -

**2h**

So this is the first entry. I started off by researching FPGA's.. and selected the Lattice ECP5 FPGA. I then verified the 256-ball BGA footprint and pad mapping - reading the CSVs was a headache lol - and reviewed the official hardware checklist. It has 24k LUTs and huge GPIO lists. In the future if I want to expand the design with DDR and HDMI.. that should be allowed too with this board. Feels really daunting but I want to be able to push my limits and build something new! Was debating against something simpler like a flight controller, but it's either win big or win Nothing!
